source: Earthdawn 4E Gamemaster's Guide — the Thread Items chapter (design + examples, pp. 197-236) and Player's Guide (weaving threads to magic items, pp. 220-225). The reference CATALOG: each thread item is a multi-rank magic item — a character weaves Legend-charged threads to it, and each Thread Rank unlocks the effects listed for that rank and below. Per-rank mechanics live in `effects` arrays in the controlled taxonomy vocabulary, so the engine gathers them exactly as it does item effects; a rank's effect replaces the previous rank's effect on the same target (never added together). Summaries are original wording, no verbatim rulebook prose; Key Knowledge text is reference data (what the owner must learn).

notes.ownership: A character owns a thread item by name in data/character.json `items` (e.g. `{ name, equipped, threadRank }`); `threadRank` is the INPUT (how many ranks woven). All derived values — active effects, Legend spent — come from it and the tier's cost progression.
notes.base: `base.effects` is the item's state with no thread attached (most thread items are mundane until a thread is woven, e.g. Faerie Mail is ordinary chain mail); an empty array means 'no effect until threaded'.
notes.threadRanks: One entry per Thread Rank, in order. `effects` are applied from Rank 1 up to the character's woven `threadRank`. `keyKnowledge` (usually at odd ranks) and `deed` record the Test Knowledge the owner must learn/research before weaving that rank — reference data. `stacking: replace` on a rank's effect models the rulebook's 'the new thread replaces the old' (a rank-3 +2 replaces the rank-1 +1; they do not sum).
notes.tier: Sets the Legend-cost progression for weaving ranks: cumulative `costs.talentRank[rank][tier]` from rules/legend.json (GMG p.202: 'correlate to the cost for increasing talent ranks'). Novice/Journeyman/Warden/Master.
notes.rankLimit: Gauge of the item's overall power — the tier table's typical maximum number of ranks (Novice 4, Journeyman 6, Warden 8, Master 10). Legendary items may exceed it; `rankLimit` on an entry is display-only reference.
notes.maximumThreads: How many characters can weave a thread to the item before the lowest-rank thread is displaced (GMG p.202). Display-only reference.
notes.mysticDefense: The item's raw magical power — the Difficulty Number for Item History tests to learn its Key Knowledges. Display-only reference.
notes.legendary: Legendary items are flagged with `legendary: true` (same shape, typically more thread ranks). Deeds are more common on legendary ranks.
notes.weavingDifficulty: The Thread Weaving test Difficulty for each Thread Rank (PG Thread Weaving Difficulty Table, p.225): 8 + rank − 1. Display-only reference.

ref.description: Flexible, silvery metal bracers that wrap around the wrists and forearms, forged with elemental water. The water gems resemble one-inch aquamarine pieces and their color constantly shifts from deep aqua to bright blue.

threadRanks.keyKnowledge: The owner must learn the Name of the bracers.
The owner must learn the Name of the mine from which came the metals used to create the bracers.

The creators of the Bracers of Aras formed the gems from a mixture of elemental air and water, and the ratio varies for each set. The owner must learn the ratio of water to air used to create the bracers he wears.

effects.summary: For 2 Strain, the owner may breathe underwater for 10 minutes.
